title: Core PvP
description: This modpack enhances your Minecraft PvP experience with better performance and other useful, mostly PvP-related mods and is allowed on nearly any popular server.
body:
Core PvP is a Minecraft **PvP** modpack focused on **improving performance** and overall gameplay while keeping the vanilla PvP experience **fair** and **competitive**. It includes many useful **PvP** and **quality-of-life features** without adding unfair advantages. Just install the pack, change your keybinds, and you're ready to play.

main features:

* performance boost + high render distance
* dynamic crosshair
* more precise sound + particle control
* cleaner hitboxes
* saturation display
* effect timer display
* waypoints
* armor HUD
* lower fire/shield
* voice chat

other features:

* option to allow java/bedrock players to your world
* more informative locator bar
* seeing everyone's ping
* fullbright/night vision
* connected textures
* shader support
* totem counter
* zoom
* durability display
* bundles show more items
* tier display
* borderless fullscreen
* way more tiny tweaks
* auto reconnect

why core pvp:

Core PvP combines useful PvP enhancements, optimization mods, and visual improvements into one clean modpack while keeping the gameplay fair and vanilla-friendly.
